beats.care: Avoid video calls with new matches. If someone threatens you, don't pay. Report it at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
beats.what: After a brief WhatsApp video call with a dating-app match, a young man was sent a fake obscene video and told to pay.
beats.why: AI tools make fake videos easy to create. Scammers use shame and fear to rush people into paying.

cards.body: He borrowed money and paid several UPI IDs between Sept 27 and 29, but the threats kept coming. He then filed an online complaint. Police have registered an FIR and are tracing the suspects.
A senior cybercrime investigator says many such cases never get reported, so the real number is likely higher.

cards.q: Would you video-call someone you just matched with?

opts: Don't pay; report it to cyber police
